scope: Repair a defect in the DL-CIN-16 story-clip integration (a877740d). DayOneDirector._emit_once() deduplicated hook events by event name alone, and the runtime seen-record is cleared only on save load. The dust_bunny_cleanup event carries the room id, so only the first room cleaned in an app session ever reached _on_day_one_hook_event: a child who cleaned the bathroom and then the pool, playroom or art room in the same sitting never saw the pool (Rumi rising), Baby Eagle or art-room completion clips. _emit_once() now takes an optional dedupe key, and the room-cleanup event is keyed per room. Every other event keeps its name-only dedupe; the seen-record is still runtime-only, so no save key or save shape changes. The director probe gains a same-session check for the later rooms' cleanup events and a check that a repeated room completion never re-emits one.
no_findings_reason: The defect was introduced by the owner-directed DL-CIN-16 story-clip integration earlier on 2026-09-23 and found by a replay-path code review the same day; it is not in the finding register. No MA-* finding covers the Day One hook events or story clips, and MA-PLAY-001 and MA-CHILD-001 keep their facts.
